I've answered Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message. The latest deadline on record for Thornbury Cloth Co.'s signed order form is **15 August**.

- **How it changed:** On 14 Oct, Marcus posted in #north-team that the deadline for the Thistle work was 24 December. Later that day he corrected it in #north-random to 15 August, saying Thornbury's ops lead had corrected him. I found nothing more recent.
- **Something looks off:** As of 17 Oct, 15 August has already passed. I suggested Ilse check with Marcus which year he meant.
- **Where the dates came from:** Both dates came from the workspace knowledge base. Those messages don't show up when I read the main history of either channel, probably because they were thread replies. Ilse is a member of both channels, so it was fine to share them with her.
- **Sharing:** A signing deadline counts as an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it didn't need approval.
